items.title: Large stable release.
items.summary:
Date: 2026-09-29 13:07 UTC
Versions: Core 0.2.1 · WorldOverhaulLoader.dll 0.2.1.0 · workshopManager.dll 0.2.1.0 · Infrastructure 0.2.1 · WorldOverhaul.dll 0.2.1.0 · Injector 0.2.1 · Content revision release-20260929T130702Z-8c9d6744

This is a large update that will hopefully be the last big update before the mod can go public. The idea is to have a week or two of testing now with hotfixes while I change some architectural stuff around to make the mod more open for third party DLL's to run on it. 

New features:
- The launcher will require one more manual installation, after that it will automatically update
- Bridges can now be merged and split freely while using the ramps
- Water and sewage switches are back and functional
- Added extensive performerance diagnostics to catch slowdowns and being able to fix them later
- A ton of new models and content, including skins 

Bug fixes:
Fixed crashes when workshop buildings use unrecognized characters
Fixed save-loading crashes involving Workshop buildings and underground meshes.
Fixed construction offices failing to find reachable construction projects.
Fixed vehicles in offices and parking buildings failing to find reachable fuel stations or horse feeders.
Fixed pedestrian connections and reachability, including residents stuck at building entrances, on tram roads, or while crossing roads.
Fixed progressive slowdowns when building and changing connections.
Restored parallel rail snapping from track ends and corrected parallel track spacing.
Fixed water failing to reach connected treatment plants.
Fixed unnecessary vehicle parsing errors from empty optional $LIGHT_BLINKER entries.
Reclassified recoverable routing and deferred-refresh messages as warnings.
Fixed unnecessary launcher restart/update prompts for the same version.

Please playtest, and don't forget to share good looking screenshots in the showoff channel!

items.title: WorldOverhaul pre-alpha testing begins
items.summary:
Welcome to the WorldOverhaul pre-alpha test phase! We are opening up this early build to test the launcher, components and their integration with Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic.

This is an unfinished development build. Many functions may not work properly yet, some features are incomplete, and you may encounter crashes, visual issues or unexpected behaviour. Updates may change how components and settings work. Please use a separate test installation and back up any saves you care about.

If something goes wrong, use the launcher's Bug report page. Tell us what happened, what you expected, and how to reproduce the issue. Screenshots and the included game logs help us investigate.

Thank you for helping us test WorldOverhaul and shape its development!
